items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, but Henry came out there and he played "Misty" on his soprano.

ctx.x: Well, the thing is, when I said they can't play melody, well, they can play melody, but what they don't know anymore is how to phrase it, so that it has -- you know, they don't give it any expression.
Yeah, but Henry came out there and he played "Misty" on his soprano. He didn't put an extra note in it and he got a standing ovation. The house was packed.
What was he doing in Kansas City?
